name: nemosyne
description: An experimental research instrument for inspectable, reproducible data investigation across desktop and WebXR.

scripts.lint: eslint src tests dev vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts vitest.coverage.config.ts vitest.fast.config.ts vitest.ui.config.ts vitest.wasm.config.ts playwright.collaboration.config.ts
scripts.lint:fix: eslint src tests dev vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts vitest.coverage.config.ts vitest.fast.config.ts vitest.ui.config.ts vitest.wasm.config.ts playwright.collaboration.config.ts --fix
scripts.format: prettier --write "src/**/*.{js,mjs,ts}" "tests/**/*.{js,mjs,ts}" "dev/**/*.{js,mjs,ts}" vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts vitest.coverage.config.ts vitest.fast.config.ts vitest.ui.config.ts vitest.wasm.config.ts playwright.collaboration.config.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "src/**/*.{js,mjs,ts}" "tests/**/*.{js,mjs,ts}" "dev/**/*.{js,mjs,ts}" vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts vitest.coverage.config.ts vitest.fast.config.ts vitest.ui.config.ts vitest.wasm.config.ts playwright.collaboration.config.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:fast && npm run test:ui && npm run test:integration && npm run test:wasm
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:integration -- tests/e2e && npm run test:wasm -- tests/e2e
scripts.test:e2e:tier1: npm run test:integration -- tests/e2e/tier1_feature_coverage && npm run test:wasm -- tests/e2e/tier1_feature_coverage
scripts.test:e2e:tier2: npm run test:integration -- tests/e2e/tier2_boundary_corner && npm run test:wasm -- tests/e2e/tier2_boundary_corner
scripts.test:e2e:tier3: npm run test:integration -- tests/e2e/tier3_cross_feature && npm run test:wasm -- tests/e2e/tier3_cross_feature
scripts.test:e2e:tier4: npm run test:integration -- tests/e2e/tier4_real_world && npm run test:wasm -- tests/e2e/tier4_real_world
scripts.deploy:netlify: npm run build && npx netlify deploy --prod --dir=dist
scripts.architecture:check: npm run architecture:deps && npm run architecture:ast:test && npm run architecture:ast
